title: Greek Tiropita
description: A classic Greek cheese pie made with crispy phyllo dough and a savory filling of lamb and feta cheese.
instructions: Cut the phyllo dough into 2-inch squares.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground lamb and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Place a phyllo square on a flat surface and brush with butter.
Place a tablespoon of the lamb and feta mixture in the center of the phyllo square.
Fold the phyllo square in half to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining phyllo squares and filling.
Place the tiropita on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with butter and bake until golden brown, about 20-25 minutes.
